column1: # Probe roster: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash against the five champions of s-2026-01.
# Six models give 15 unordered pairs, and every pair plays both coins in both
# directions: 60 matches at ROUNDS=1. Flash is cheap enough that the bill is
# almost entirely the champion it plays — a 29-round flash probe in s-2026-01
# cost $12.44, of which flash's own side was $1.04.
# opus-5.5 and gpt-6.1 refuse the attack prompt and the defender's exploit work
# on provider policy (content_filter); their matches settle as ABSTAIN_* and
# give no comparison. Drop them from this file for a probe that plays out.
